items.title: The intersection of two scheme theoretically dense open subspaces is scheme theoretically dense

items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: if U and V are scheme theoretically dense open subspaces of an algebraic space X over S, then so is their intersection (source lines 3551-3556). The proof uses the characterization of scheme theoretic density by injectivity of O_X -> j_*O_U on etale objects: for an etale W -> X the restriction map O(W) -> O(W x_X V) -> O(W x_X (V intersect U)) is a composite of two injective maps, hence injective, and the characterization gives the conclusion.
